topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well now, isn’t that somethin’? Our old neighbor, Alaric, always seemed like he had nary a coin to rub together, living in that small cottage and working his patch of earth like the rest of us. Just the other day, I saw him bring out a chest, and it was full to the brim with gold! Who would’ve thought? He’s been hidin’ a fortune all this time. Maybe with his help, we can mend the church roof or get some new seeds for the village. It’s a good day, and I reckon St. Francis might just be smiling down on us. A wealth of gold can do a lot of good, if it’s in the right hands. Let’s hope Alaric shares his blessing with the rest of us.
